description: The Twente Canal Digital Twin Demonstrator is a corridor-scale digital twin platform for inland waterway logistics on the Twente Canal in the Netherlands, developed in an Engineering Doctorate project at the University of Twente. Version 1.0 integrates several data sources into one dashboard: water level monitoring, weather forecasts, AIS vessel tracking and the status of canal infrastructure, together with a publish-and-match function for logistics. It is meant to support operational decisions in inland waterway logistics by improving situational awareness and short-term planning. Coverage is one canal corridor. Access: the source code of version 1.0 is a free 6 MB zip download on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, published 2026-02-21. Caveats: it is a single-developer demonstrator, not a maintained product, and the live data feeds it connects to may need their own access. It supports inland waterway digital twins, disruption awareness from low or high water and lock or bridge outages, and short-term logistics planning, and relates to the EU inland fairway network graphs catalogued here.
name: Twente Canal Digital Twin Demonstrator
